newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo share rises to year high on result.
newsitem.headline: Novo share rises to year high on result.

text.p: Shares in Danish drugs and biotechnology group Novo Nordisk rose to an all-year high on Wednesday after the group posted a 1.893 billion crown pre-tax profit for 1996's first nine months, four percent up on the same period last year.
The result was better than analysts' average expectations of a 1.852 billion crowns pre-tax profit for the period.

The Novo share traded at 1,010 crowns prior to being suspended for 12 minutes for the result announcement. Minutes after the suspension the paper rose to 1,016, an all-year high level, and dealers saw the share holding the higher price.
